[center][b][font=Tahoma][size=3]This is a mod that replaces the villagers and other NPC's portraits created by me.[/size][/font][/b]

[b]How to download: [/b]


[list=1]
[*]Download [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999/?]Platonymous's Portraiture Mod[/url]﻿ and follow the instructions 
[*]Download the zip file, and extract the folder with the portraits in to [b]Portraiture > Portraits [/b]
[*]Launch the game as normal and enjoy the portraits! 
[/list]
